plugin.name: atlas
plugin._long: Present all outputs as one logical desktop for overview and window switching. Wall shows the global workspace grid; ring and ring_all show every window on the current or all workspaces; switch and switch_all are a cross-output alt+tab.

option.name: wall
option._long: Toggle the global workspace-grid overview across all outputs.

option.name: ring
option._long: Toggle a global ring of the windows on the current workspace across all outputs.

option.name: ring_all
option._long: Toggle a global ring of every window across all workspaces and outputs.

option.name: switch
option._long: Open a held-modifier MRU switcher across all outputs for the current workspace. Hold the modifier and press Tab to cycle (Shift to reverse); release to focus the centred window, Escape to cancel.

option.name: switch_all
option._long: As switch, but over every window on every workspace and output.

option.name: duration
option._long: Length of the open and close animation.

option.name: inactive_brightness
option._long: Brightness of non-selected cells or windows (0..1).

option.name: gap_size
option._long: Pixels of gap between cells or windows in the layout.

option.name: anim_duration
option._long: Milliseconds for every atlas open/close animation: the ring's thumbnails sliding between their real positions and the grid, and the wall's zoom between the current workspace and the grid. One global knob for all modes; tunable live via a config reload.

option.name: debug_log
option._long: Log activation and teardown to the session log.
